proves.claim: new static, re-export and literal dynamic imports through a compatibility shim are refused

codemap.io-shim-ratchet.added-import-ref.why: A new dependency must cross the moved cell through its public front door.

proves.claim: before and accepted declaration multisets, including duplicate counts, remain allowed

codemap.io-shim-ratchet.unchanged-multis.why: Existing dependencies must not be mistaken for newly introduced imports.

proves.claim: only an exact criterion edge with valid unexpired metadata permits a shim import

codemap.io-shim-ratchet.temporary-edge-i.why: Temporary migration authority must remain exact and time bounded.

proves.claim: a change with no added import does not read the cells plan

codemap.io-shim-ratchet.no-added-import-.why: Unrelated edits should not incur plan reads or plan parsing.

proves.claim: an added import without the canonical parser is refused

codemap.io-shim-ratchet.parser-required.why: Import admission must use the compile-only canonical parser.

proves.claim: noncanonical plan shard paths retain their explicit refusal

codemap.io-shim-ratchet.malformed-plan-r.why: Malformed plans must not authorize imports through shims.

proves.claim: Distinct dated first-parent commits retain the original shim mapping introduction date after source edits and relocation into a cell shard.

codemap.io-shim-lifecycle.first-parent-d.why: A filesystem timestamp or a later edit must not reset shim age.

codemap.io-shim-lifecycle.exact-selected.why: History results must match the snapshot being inspected.

proves.claim: Never-present and physically removed shim files are excluded; actionable exact-path native removal work ranks before verified or cell-wide work.

codemap.io-shim-lifecycle.removal-item-c.why: Removal advice must refer to extant shims and actionable work.
